verdict.rationale: Steel documents its own Files API ('API Endpoints for managing Files on Steel'), which points to first-party file handling for sessions. The evidence is a single thin reference: it never describes capturing site downloads, uploading files into pages, or retrieving artifacts after a session. Screenshot/PDF tools and trace ZIP exports are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented capture of browser downloads, documented file upload to sites, documented post-session artifact retrieval, hands-on corroboration.
